title: Delegated template-fallback plans reach the governed delivery-injection authority — TRUE Telegram intent no longer un-plannable (BUG 4)
description: Live evidence: delegated work item DL_4d48de10 spawned mission MSN_01M4PGEKGX97NGQJJEM971GYSZ which failed terminally at planning — FAIL_CLOSED_DELIVERY_TASK_MISSING, DETERMINISTIC. Cause: delegated missions carry no pinned_plan_tasks/llm_plan, so the planner falls to the deterministic template fallback which never emitted TELEGRAM_DELIVERY and never passed the DELIVERY_TASK_INJECTED seam (it lived only inside canonicalizeLlmTasks). Fix: extracted the injection block into injectDeliveryTaskForTrueOmission — ONE shared governed authority called by canonicalize AND by the fresh template fallback; on injection the SAME canonical mutation authority reconcilePlanDataflow rewrites the canonical staging instruction and stamps manifest/plan-contract/language/producer edges. Template T2 no longer embeds the goal verbatim (an affirmative delivery clause inside a work instruction trips assertTaskDeliveryHygiene + assertTaskDeliverySemantic); goal stays durable in mission_goal.txt. Preferred mandate path (route whole template list through canonicalizeLlmTasks) documented contract-incompatible: hygiene trips on embedded goal; assertPlanCoverage imposes obligations a generic template cannot satisfy — would trade MISSING for PLAN_INCOMPLETE. Preserved: persisted/pinned replay, replan provider seam, validatePlanProposal/assertPlanDataflow/digest pinning, fail-closed unservable (DELIVERY_INJECTION_UNSERVABLE), forged PAIR_DELIVERY_INJECTION_KEY stripped then re-stamped only on PAIR-injected task, single injection implementation. Tests 15/15: BEFORE old-shape fails MISSING, AFTER commits [T1,T2,T3:TELEGRAM_DELIVERY]; FALSE intent injects zero; forged stamp stripped; replan/replay unchanged; external inputs thread reconcile; delivery task is DAG leaf. Regressions 375 pass; 1 baseline failure on BASE cf2674c (pair-f4-delivery-provenance R5.1-crash, unrelated module).
